Subject: Recap & next steps — Novus Retail trial kickoff

Hi Sam — great to connect this morning. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight plan so we can lock on deliverables and owners.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary objective: validate Redwood inference reduces false-positive rate on product-match suggestions and speeds up batch scoring (goal: 30% fewer manual overrides; 40% faster batch time).
- Scope for trial: 3 weeks, non-production test environment with a 2M-row sample export.
- Team on your side: Sam (POC lead), procurement@novusretail.com (purchase), engineering contact TBD.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm)
- Functional: end-to-end pipeline with prefix caching enabled, sample inference runs without errors.
- Quantitative: >=30% reduction in manual override rate on sample set; per-batch throughput improvement >=40%.
- Qualitative: Satisfies integration checklist items 1–6 in attached MOP.

High-level timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): access & test dataset ingest; Redwood provides MOP and onboarding guide (attached: novus_trial_mop_v1.pdf).
- Week 1: integration & baseline runs (owner: Marissa Cole).
- Week 2: evaluation and metrics collection (owner: Priyom Das).
- Week 3: acceptance window and handoff to ops (owner: Monica Patel).

Immediate asks from Novus
1) Confirm the success criteria above or add anything we've missed.
2) Share the sample dataset export (S3 link) and engineering contact for access.
3) If procurement needs a preliminary order form, loop them in (we can send a DocuSign starter).

Next steps from Redwood
- I will share a formal playbook (MOP v2) with timelines and checklist by Monday.
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff with engineering once we have dataset/access.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Novus Retail trial kickoff

Thanks Avery — good notes. I made a few quick edits inline (see below). Two clarifications from our side:

1) Timeline: our leadership would prefer a tighter timeline if possible — can we aim for a 2-week focused evaluation (compress week 1+2) and then an optional week 3 for buffer?
2) Data: we can provide a 1.2M-row sample (sanitized) by close of day Monday. Will you need a full S3 path or can we share a signed temporary transfer?

Additional success metric request:
- We care about model drift detection — if you can provide a simple weekly drift delta on top of the manual override reduction that would help our analytics team.

On procurement: looping them in to confirm required paperwork.

Subject: Trial plan & owners — Novus Retail (MOP v2)

Sam — thanks for the quick reply and for offering the sample dataset. We can compress the evaluation into 2 focused weeks with an optional week 3 for buffer; below is an updated plan and a short checklist for engineering. MOP v2 attached (novus_trial_mop_v2.pdf).

Updated plan (2-week focused run + optional buffer)- Day 0 (Mon): dataset transfer + access verification (Redwood engineering provides test account + API key). Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Days 1–5: integration & baseline inference runs (Marissa). Deliverable: baseline report with error logs.
- Days 6–10: metric collection & drift check (Priyom Das). Deliverable: metric pack (manual override rates, latency/throughput, drift delta).
- Day 11–14: acceptance window (Monica Patel) — validation against success criteria and final sign-off.

Engineering checklist (high level)
- Provide S3 presigned URL or secure transfer by Mon EOD.
- Confirm test IAM role/read permissions for Redwood service account.
- Run baseline script (we'll supply) and share run id/logs.

Procurement / commercial
- Ben, can you confirm whether we should send a draft order form now or wait until we hit baseline results? If procurement needs net-30 or an internal PO, flag it now.

Links / files
- Playbook (attached): novus_trial_mop_v2.pdf
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/72019
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/novus-trial

I'll set up two recurring 30-min check-ins (integration & metrics) for the trial window; prefer Tue/Thu cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
Avery
